picks.text: The street lights exiting Bowie high school onto slaughter Lane will not allow vehicles to leave the Bowie parking lot. You need to have somebody come out and monitor these lights for at least an hour after school lets out we’ve been sitting here for 20 minutes and the light has not turned green on us.

The left-turn signal from W Parmer Ln onto Riata Vista Cir is not cycling. Vehicles in the two left-turn lanes waited over 15 minutes without a green arrow while opposing traffic cycled four times.
